edited_fraction: three scalars in executed studies (0.0616%-0.0651% of tiny networks); <0.1% cap proposed for diffusion U-Nets
evidence_notes: A 'technical report' (p2) proposing GPT-6 Astra / Qwen3-VL editing of diffusion SR U-Nets; the measured studies use a seeded numerical search over three biases of 4,611-6,147-parameter networks and 'do not test an LLM editor' (p6-7), so no LLM mechanism or editor was executed. Tables 2-5 (p6-7) print editor results (e.g. Astra +0.041 MANIQA, 72% preference) while only Tables 6-7 are labelled measured. The executed feedback score improved while unseen-scene quality worsened (p7-8).
